name: MeadowTurf
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.124

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: ambientCG Grass004 (2x2) height-blended with Grass001 (2x2, shifted) and Poly Haven leafy_grass (true scale, worn patches), plus plants modelled here in Blender and baked top-down as decals (clover patches, plantain, daisy and dandelion rosettes, a few daisy flowers, dry leaves and straw blades); graded toward the original grass palette
known_weaknesses: plants are stamped decals in albedo, normal and AO with only a few millimetres of height: they do not stand up at grazing view; the 1.4 m lawn period can still be found in a flat-lit 4x4 view
